people.reference: a mother and her young son (unnamed)

raw: Voice note, end of the day. Drove up to the village this morning with a box of supplies. A mother brought her little boy over with a fever, three days now, and they hadn't gone to the hospital because they'd be charged the foreigner rate they can't pay. Checked him over, started him on what he needed, and arranged to cover the trip into town if the fever doesn't break by tomorrow. Sat afterwards and wrote his history into the notebook. As far as I can tell it's the first time anyone has written down that this child exists. Solar pump was running the whole time, and a couple of the older kids were weaving by the window. Tired, but it was a good day.
